applicability_rule: Capabilities named by OM-021, capabilities used by the three live workflows, and adjacent GitHub controls required to enforce their security, semantic-population, provenance, cancellation, fork, artifact, and activation boundaries.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners avoid granting repository workflows standing access to a maintained self-hosted machine.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: The live workflow and latest exact-main jobs consistently declare ubuntu-latest and expose a stable runner-class identity for paired comparisons.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: The organization Free plan and existing public-repository execution establish the current baseline without a newly accepted paid-runner cost.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: The runner class is retained as the comparison baseline; changing runner class during a benchmark would invalidate the timing pair.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: The service is scoped to the coverage job and carries no repository or publication credentials.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: DB-enabled coverage depends on PostgreSQL readiness and must not be removed or moved behind an unproved shard.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: The service already executes on the standard hosted runner and has no separately observed billing decision.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Container initialization is measured separately from test execution so future setup changes do not hide DB-population changes.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Only the content-addressed pnpm store may be cached; node_modules, DEVAI state, verdicts, coverage, and evidence are excluded, and frozen installation always executes.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Cache hit or miss changes dependency acquisition duration only and cannot change selected commands, test population, or verdict.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: No cache currently exists, so storage and eviction behavior must be measured before activation.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Adoption targets repeated frozen-install time but requires positive equal-population paired median evidence.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Reusable setup must declare every input, output, permission, toolchain identity, cache boundary, and calling workflow identity.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Composition removes duplicated plumbing without hiding commands or changing the population executed by each caller.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Centralized setup lowers maintenance cost but provides no activation standing until workflow contracts pass.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Composition is retained if it improves operability even when runtime savings are neutral, provided it introduces no extra serial edge.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Explicit needs edges prevent a downstream authoritative job from running on absent or failed prerequisites.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Only independent complete populations may run in parallel; build, T1/T2, DB coverage, and T4/T5/T6 order remain explicit.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Parallel independent work can reduce billed elapsed time only when it does not duplicate expensive populations unsafely.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: The current 35m16s path identifies stage 2 and coverage as dominant, but no edge is removed without semantic proof.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: A matrix is permitted only when every cell is a closed declared population and cannot omit its own selector.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Matrix expansion preserves exact-once complete cell membership; unproved test-file or case sharding is excluded.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Matrix overhead is acceptable only when paired evidence shows a positive critical-path or operability benefit.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Cells may shorten independent work but cannot split serial tier or instrumentation semantics.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Only superseded pull-request feedback may be cancelled; authoritative events cannot lose terminal evidence.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Main, merge-group, frozen-candidate, convergence, sentinel, and round-close runs use non-cancelling identities.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Cancelling obsolete PR feedback avoids waste without reducing authoritative population.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Cancellation affects queue consumption, not the measured duration or standing of an authoritative run.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Every external action reference is a literal 40-hex commit SHA with a readable version comment.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Exact action bytes remain stable across reruns of one candidate.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Pin maintenance is accepted as a security requirement independent of timing.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: The feature is retained for provenance even if it has no measurable speed benefit.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: The live workflows grant contents read and no broad write permission; future jobs must declare only the permissions they consume.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: A validation job cannot acquire publication, pull-request, release, or settings authority from its executor kind.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Least privilege is a hard security property and is not traded for timing.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Permission checks are retained regardless of measured duration.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: The repository setting currently permits workflows to approve pull-request reviews, but R-0007 validation jobs have no need for that authority and must not receive pull-request write permission.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: No validation, report, classifier, sentinel, or cold-proof command depends on approving a pull request.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: The capability has no CI wall-time or operability benefit for this round; changing the live setting remains a separately authorized administrative action.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: The capability is excluded from workflow implementation and timing comparisons.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Fork pull requests cannot save or restore privileged cache namespaces and no cache path may include DEVAI state, pins, credentials, outputs, or verdicts.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Fork identity and event type participate in cache policy without changing validation selection.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Cold fork acquisition is accepted where isolation prevents cache poisoning.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Fork performance never justifies crossing trust namespaces.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Every artifact upload declares a retention period no greater than the live 90-day repository maximum and excludes secrets and DEVAI authority state.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Retention changes availability of transport bytes only, never gate truth.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Short explicit retention bounds storage consumption; exact duration is selected per artifact purpose during implementation.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Upload and verification time is measured independently before an artifact edge is activated.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Reports are non-authoritative observations and cannot carry credentials or substitute for command exits.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Structured file, suite, case, coverage, and command counts make population equality mechanically comparable.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Generation cost must be recorded and bounded against its diagnostic value.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Report generation remains off the critical path where it can run after the producing command without hiding failure.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Annotations render existing diagnostics and never create or override a verdict.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Machine diagnostics retain their stable code, path, and command identity when presented in the GitHub UI.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Bounded annotations reduce triage cost without requiring retained binary artifacts.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Annotation rendering is measured as reporting overhead and cannot gate before the underlying exit is known.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Summaries are derived display surfaces with no authority and escape untrusted content before rendering.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Each summary identifies exact base, candidate, class, selected and omitted commands, cold-lane state, and source report digests.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Small textual summaries reduce operator inspection time with negligible storage.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Summary publication occurs after command completion and is included in reporting telemetry.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Telemetry excludes secrets and mutable authority claims and binds exact workflow, runner, candidate, and cache state.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Queue, setup, install, job, gate, artifact-verification, and critical-path durations are reported separately after population equality.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Telemetry is required to reject optimizations that do not produce a positive median benefit.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Repeated same-runner measurements, not anecdotal duration, govern activation.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Producer manifests bind every transported byte digest and consumers verify digests; artifact storage itself remains unauthenticated for PASS.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Artifacts may carry reports or inter-job bytes but never a verdict, omitted command, coverage standing, or R-0008 claim.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Upload, download, retention, and verification costs must be lower than duplicated recomputation or provide a separate operability benefit.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Artifact verification time is recorded and included before judging any critical-path saving.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: The lane has no publication or merge proof standing and cannot lower the mechanically derived class.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: It executes the classifier-selected complete closure and reports every omission with a reason.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: The lane targets faster developer feedback while the cold lane preserves authoritative cost.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Its timing is reported separately and cannot be presented as cold-proof duration.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: The lane starts without DEVAI result reuse and retains exact permissions, immutable actions, and fork isolation.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: It executes the complete active close-profile population with literal independent commands and unchanged coverage floors.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Complete proof cost is retained; only acquisition caching that cannot change verdict is eligible.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Frozen candidate, main authority, sentinel, convergence, and round close are measured and completed without cancellation.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: The sentinel can only disable narrowing; absent, malformed, stale, or unauthenticated health cannot enable it.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: It compares the predicted command population with complete same-candidate cold execution and names every false negative.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Scheduled and main-bound complete runs are the retained cost of detecting classifier omissions.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: A false negative immediately returns the complete fallback plan and blocks any speed claim.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: A restored installation tree can contain mutable scripts, links, or platform-specific bytes outside frozen resolution.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Skipping frozen installation would let cache state alter executable dependency bytes and verdict.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Any speed benefit surrenders a required proof property and is therefore ineligible.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: The slower frozen installation is retained rather than accepting an unsound shortcut.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: GitHub cache bytes have no signer, trust epoch, or authenticated claim binding.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: A cache key or hit cannot substitute for a command, test, coverage, or evidence verdict.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Result-reuse savings belong to R-0008 and cannot be purchased by weakening proof.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Complete execution remains the fallback until authenticated reuse is separately authorized and proved.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: A tag or branch can resolve to different third-party bytes without changing the repository candidate.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Mutable action resolution breaks exact-candidate reproducibility.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Convenient upgrades do not outweigh provenance loss.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Timing is irrelevant because the feature violates a hard action-identity rule.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: An incomplete shard can conceal a failing test or instrumentation interaction.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Only mechanically complete matrix cells or affected-test closure may partition work.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Unproved wall-time saving has no standing when population is reduced.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: The complete population is retained until exact-once shard coverage is proved.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Artifact names, storage, and ordinary digests do not authenticate a DEVAI claim producer or trust root.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Transported PASS bytes cannot omit local execution or satisfy a gate in R-0007.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Avoided execution is not an eligible saving before R-0008 authenticated reuse.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Artifact verification time is measured only as transport overhead, never as a replacement proof.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: No self-hosted runner is registered and R-0007 has no host-hardening, credential-isolation, lifecycle, or incident authority for one.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Mutable host state would introduce an unbound environment into exact-candidate proof.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Maintenance and security costs are unaccepted.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Potential speed does not justify an ungoverned runner trust boundary.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: GitHub-hosted isolation would remain preferable to self-hosting, but the exact runner entitlement is unproved.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Any evaluation must hold source, population, and runner class constant within each baseline/candidate pair.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: The organization Free plan provides no accepted larger-runner cost authority in this round.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: No speed claim is made without live availability and paired runner-class evidence.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: A merge queue requires explicit protected-check identities and administrative configuration not currently present.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: A later queue must trigger the complete non-cancellable cold lane for the merge-group SHA.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Availability and administrative cost are unproved.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Queue-time effects cannot be benchmarked before the feature exists and its required population is bound.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: No ruleset exists and creating one is an external administrative mutation requiring separate authority.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: A later ruleset must require stable fast and complete cold check identities without treating fast feedback as close proof.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: No settings change or plan cost is accepted by this policy commit.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Required-check waiting time is measured only after an authorized ruleset exists.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Main is not branch-protected and protection mutation is outside the local B2 authority.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Any later required-check population must be nonempty, exact-SHA bound, deterministic, and include cold authority where applicable.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: The policy records no accepted administrative or queue cost.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: No required-check duration claim is possible while the feature is absent.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: The repository currently allows all actions; narrowing the platform allowlist is desirable only after a complete workflow-call census and separate settings authority.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: The source checker remains the active fail-closed protection and must continue scanning every workflow.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: No administrative activation cost is accepted here.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: The control is security-oriented and is not justified by a speed claim.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Platform SHA enforcement is currently disabled; the source checker already rejects mutable references and remains mandatory.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: A later platform control is defense in depth and cannot replace repository validation.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Availability and administrative mutation authority are unproved.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: The control has security value independent of wall time but is not active.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: First-time contributor approval is retained as an existing platform boundary, while workflows independently avoid privileged cache and secret use.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Approval never changes the mechanically selected validation population.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Human approval latency is accepted for new contributor trust and is not counted as test critical path.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Queue time is recorded separately from executable workflow duration.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: OIDC subject, audience, issuer, trust epoch, and verifier policy belong to the separately gated R-0008 trust design.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: An unverified token or subject cannot authenticate a DEVAI result claim.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Identity integration and verification cost are not accepted in R-0007.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Identity verification time will be measured in R-0008 before authenticated reuse activation.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: Attestation issuer, subject, predicate, digest, trust root, and verification policy require the R-0008 Owner binding.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: An unverified attestation never satisfies a DEVAI gate.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Generation, storage, and verification costs remain unmeasured.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Attestation verification time must be included in later paired evidence.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: R-0007 has no authorized GitHub or offline signer trust root for equivalent result claims.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: Fast and cold R-0007 lanes execute their selected commands; whole-gate reuse among ordinary, stage2, and coverage is not inferred.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: Potential avoided execution is explicitly deferred to R-0008.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: No reuse saving is included in the R-0007 optimization benchmark.

feature_dispositions.security_rationale: No environment exists and R-0007 has no deployment or environment-secret authority.
feature_dispositions.semantic_rationale: A deployment gate is outside the CLI and CI-foundation claim ceiling.
feature_dispositions.cost_rationale: No deployment infrastructure or administrative cost is authorized.
feature_dispositions.critical_path_rationale: Deployment is excluded from R-0007 CI timing and cannot be added as an optimization dependency.
